propositions: Adapter exposes a Pydantic TextOutputFunc that wraps structured.parse_structured to perform deterministic parse, validation, and sentinel/decoy selection, raising ModelRetry on retryable StructuredOutputError while preserving the original Rebar error in __cause__ chain.

Adapter implements an after_model_request capability hook that calls structured.check_response to guard against provider stop/refusal/content-filter signals, raising terminal UnretryableOutputError (non-retryable) for refusals or retryable StructuredOutputError for transient errors, executing before output-function text processing.
structured.py parse_structured and check_response remain unchanged pure entry points; adapter introduces no new public pure interfaces and preserves parser behavior byte-for-byte.

Adapter adds no retry loop, provider selection, usage projection, or persistence logic; Pydantic AI drives bounded retry via ModelRetry while adapter runs guard-before-parse ordering as it exists today.

Contract tests verify valid native and prompted responses produce typed objects through real Pydantic Agent, historical repair/sentinel/decoy corpus retains same values, retryable failures preserve exact Rebar error identity in cause chain, and refusals abort after one model call with no retry prompt.
Adapter integration pattern uses output_type=TextOutput(fn) and capabilities=[cap] on real Pydantic Agent to wire deterministic authorities without scheduler/fallback/usage changes.
